name: Stendel's Pond
label: Place
description: Gnolls prowl Stendel's Pond southwest of Sentinel Hill, where anglers still seek fresh fish.
intro: Gnolls prowl Stendel's Pond southwest of Sentinel Hill, where anglers still seek fresh fish.

p: Southwest of Sentinel Hill, Stendel's Pond draws anglers despite the danger along its muddy banks. Gnolls roam nearby, and scattered skeletons with two lone graves show that the shore is perilous. The water may be foul, or the beasts may be to blame, but the cause is unknown. Schools of sagefish still bring anglers to the pond.
